The subject is wearing grey heathered crew socks and mustard-yellow leather slip-on shoes (resembling clogs or loafers). The socks feature a distinct ribbed cuff at the top and a solid knit texture on the leg portion. The shoes have a visible seam across the vamp and a dark sole. The background consists of a light-colored wall with a black baseboard.
